update_reason: AKALYNTH_FDROID_SIGNER_ROTATION_PLAN_V1 completed. Confirmed distinctions between keys and insufficient custody evidence. Stronger blocker recorded per plan decision.

repo_index_key.purpose: F-Droid repository / index signing (used when adding repo to F-Droid client; signs index-v*.jar, metadata)

fdroid_v5_apk_signer.purpose: The certificate that signed the actual akalynth-beta.apk published to the F-Droid repo
fdroid_v5_apk_signer.note: This is the APK app signing key, distinct from the repo/index key above

direct_v12_channel.note: Separate channel. Direct v12 signer MUST NOT be reused for F-Droid

key_distinctions.repo_index_key_vs_apk_signer: The F-Droid repo/index signing key (7517DE35...) is distinct from the certificate that signed the v5 APK (b58026...). Changing the repo key affects repo trust/fingerprint for adding to F-Droid. Changing the APK signer affects whether existing F-Droid users can update in place.
key_distinctions.direct_vs_fdroid: Direct channel and F-Droid channel use completely different signers and update authorities. They are intentionally not aligned.
key_distinctions.keystore: The keystore.p12 with alias akalynth_fdroid_repo is configured for repo signing. Exact mapping to the observed v5 APK signer (b58026...) is unconfirmed from inspected evidence.

signing_custody.note: Signing key custody was not inspected. Does not authorize signing, keystore access, or use. Signer age (~4 weeks for v5) does not equal custody proof or authority. Existing keystore cannot be used without explicit, approved custody proof.

rotation_implications.if_apk_signer_changes: Existing F-Droid installs will NOT be able to update in place (signature mismatch on com.akalynth.client). Users will require uninstall + fresh install. This creates a new trust line.
rotation_implications.if_repo_key_changes: Users will need to re-add the F-Droid repository using the new fingerprint.
